title: Timing / cadence

questions.text: Even if this is the right action, is now the right time to send/do it?

inputs: customer timezone / meeting schedule where known

criteria.text: the expected response window is respected
criteria.guide: Do not send before the window the customer opened has elapsed, nor after it closed.
A promised deadline that is due or past means act now (or it is late).

criteria.text: the system is not firing instantly on every graph change
criteria.guide: Minutes after our own last touch, or during an activity burst, waiting is usually right.

principles: This should stop the system from firing instantly on every graph change.

labels.label: TOO_EARLY
labels.when: Acting now is too early (the window has not elapsed); waiting is right.

labels.label: READY
labels.when: Now is the right time to act.

labels.label: LATE_OR_MISSED_WINDOW
labels.when: The window has passed or is about to pass; acting late or not at all misses it.

labels.label: NO_ACTION_NEEDED
labels.when: No timing question arises because nothing needs doing.

labels.label: INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT
labels.when: Timestamps or stated timing are missing.

diagnostics.name: too_early
diagnostics.when: the action comes before the window elapsed
